ModMetaData.name: Better Work Tab
ModMetaData.author: Coolnether123
ModMetaData.description: Completely overhauls RimWorld’s Work tab with drag-and-drop, skill overlays, automation rules, and visual customization. All features are toggleable in settings with extensive customization options. Features • Drag & drop reordering • Skill level overlay (hold SHIFT) • Auto-assignment rulesets • Workload presets • Visual dividers • Force pawns to work on unassigned tasks • Advanced Pawn and Column highlighting • Angled column headers • Colonist / bed counts • Right-click pawn quick actions (Rename/Background color) • Multiplayer support (With Zetrith Multiplayer mod) • Many settings to tweak and add functionality Compatibility • Compatible with most work-type mods • May conflict with other work-tab overhauls Version Difference • 1.6 -> v1.0.5 • 1.5 -> v1.0.5 • 1.4 -> v1.0.5 • 1.3 -> v1.0.5 • 1.2 -> v1.0.5 - Multiplayer does not work • 1.1 -> v1.0.5 - Multiplayer does not work • 1.0 -> v1.0.5 - Multiplayer does not work Support Questions, bug reports, or suggestions?
